items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 20 at 8:22PM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
items.description:
At 822 PM EDT/722 PM CDT/, Doppler radar was tracking a strong
thunderstorm 9 miles northwest of Stonemill Creek, or 17 miles east
of Callaway, moving west at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Panama City, Lynn Haven, Panama City Beach, Callaway, Springfield,
Hiland Park, Tyndall Air Force Base, Parker, St Andrews State Park,
Southport, Cedar Grove, Dirego Park, Beacon Beach, College Station,
Bayou George, West Panama City, Camp Flowers, Bahama Beach, Biltmore
Beach, and Kinard.
items.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.
